description: Cross-component integration — event-sourcing invariants (REST aggregate counts == events fold), replay scrubber determinism (UI at scrubIndex=N == fresh fold of events[0..N]), MCP↔proxy attribution invariants. Pair with the event-replay-auditor + integration-auditor specialists.

gates.name: integration.eventSourcingInvariant
gates.description: Every dedicated REST endpoint aggregate count must equal the fold of the corresponding events. integration.invariantsPassed / integration.invariantsTested = 1.0.

gates.name: integration.replayDeterminism
gates.description: For every probed scrubIndex N, the UI rendered at scrubIndex=N must equal a fresh fold of events[0..N]. integration.replayDeterministic / integration.replayProbes = 1.0.

gates.name: integration.attributionAccuracy
gates.description: SDK sub-agent tool-uses must be attributed to the correct sub-agent (not the orchestrator). integration.attributionsCorrect / integration.attributionsProbed ≥ 0.95.
